method: Observed the actual native player during repeated playback and paused/seeked checks, plus original rendered start/middle/end pixels. This is sampled visual QA, not continuous motion capture or a cross-device timing benchmark.
observations: All five props remain present; both bread plates are empty and uncut.
Near tea is sharper at the beginning; the empty cup is clearer near the end. The shift is gentle, not a dramatic attention guarantee.
Camera motion and framing stay consistent across sampled phases.
Metal reflection and amber liquid remain readable; fine render grain is still visible.
Black side bars in the wide player window preserve the square video rather than stretching it.
frame_drop_counter_note: Initial playback log reported fd=0. Intentional seeking later raised the cumulative counter to 62; this seek-affected counter is not used as a playback-performance result.
close_note: The quit key closed the window. Its subsequent key-up event reported a stale X11 window; fresh window inventory verified the player was gone and original windows remained.
limitations: 12 fps and remaining render grain are intentional disclosed delivery limits.
The six-second shot is not a seamless loop.
No claim that all frames were individually judged in every player or display.
